hook.name: PotatoV4Hook
hook.description: A token launch platform hook that manages bonding curve-style launches. Takes a 1% fee on buy swaps via BeforeSwapDelta (burns fee tokens on sells), enforces a 4-second anti-snipe window at launch, caps per-wallet token holdings, and tracks graduation when a quote-token liquidity threshold is reached. Fees are split among creator, protocol, and referrer.
